_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-05-07 14:29:36Z)**_

問題很清楚了。`homebrew` role 每次 `chezmoi apply` 都無條件跑 `brew update`，而 `upgrade_tools.sh brew` 已經有 `brew update + upgrade` 的專屬升級路徑。這違反了 CLAUDE.md 的「install vs upgrade 分離」原則，且 `brew update` 是 git fetch 操作，久未更新時會拉大量 commit。

最佳解：加 **24 小時 freshness guard**，只在 FETCH_HEAD 超過一天才重跑。

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-05-07 14:29:50Z)**_

好。邏輯：

- 讀 `/opt/homebrew/.git/FETCH_HEAD`（Intel 機器改用 `/usr/local/Homebrew/`）的 mtime
- 若距今 **< 24 小時** → 跳過 `brew update`（顯示 `skipping`）
- 若超過 24 小時或 FETCH_HEAD 不存在 → 才真正執行

**為什麼 16 分鐘**：`brew update` 是 `git fetch`，如果很久沒跑，會拉幾百個 commit 的差量，在網路慢或 GitHub CDN 擁塞時特別明顯。這個改法讓同一天內重複跑 `chezmoi apply` 時這步直接 skip，只有真的需要新 formula 資料才去拉。

顯式升級仍走 `just upgrade-brew` → `upgrade_tools.sh brew`，那邊本來就有 `brew update + upgrade`，不受影響。

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-05-07 14:35:31Z)**_

修復有效，`Update Homebrew` 從 16 分鐘變成直接 skip（不在輸出裡），整體從 ~18 分鐘降到 1m40s。

關於 `ansible_date_time`：它需要 `gather_facts: true` + 網路連線（抓時區資訊），playbook 雖有設定，但在某些 macOS 環境下 `setup` module 的 `date_time` fact 有時不穩定。`lookup('pipe', 'date +%s')` 直接 shell 取值更可靠，所以這樣改是對的。

現在 commit：

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-05-07 14:35:32Z)**_

<tool-use data-tool-type="shell" data-tool-name="Bash"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Bash**</summary>
Show diff of homebrew role changes

`git diff dot_ansible/roles/homebrew/tasks/main.yml`

```text
diff --git a/dot_ansible/roles/homebrew/tasks/main.yml b/dot_ansible/roles/homebrew/tasks/main.yml
index 4d2c66c..1125ad4 100644
--- a/dot_ansible/roles/homebrew/tasks/main.yml
+++ b/dot_ansible/roles/homebrew/tasks/main.yml
@@ -22,8 +22,18 @@
   ansible.builtin.debug:
     msg: "Homebrew not installed. It should be installed by bootstrap script."
 
-- name: Update Homebrew
+# Only update if FETCH_HEAD is older than 24 h — brew update is a slow git fetch
+# and upgrade_tools.sh brew already runs it on explicit upgrade runs.
+- name: Check when Homebrew was last updated
   when: homebrew_installed
+  ansible.builtin.stat:
+    path: "{{ homebrew_arm.stat.exists | ternary('/opt/homebrew', '/usr/local/Homebrew') }}/.git/FETCH_HEAD"
+  register: brew_fetch_head
+
+- name: Update Homebrew
+  when:
+    - homebrew_installed
+    - not brew_fetch_head.stat.exists or (lookup('pipe', 'date +%s') | int - brew_fetch_head.stat.mtime | int) > 86400
   community.general.homebrew:
     update_homebrew: true
   ignore_errors: true
```
</details></tool-use>

<tool-use data-tool-type="shell" data-tool-name="Bash"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Bash**</summary>
Commit homebrew role 24h freshness guard

```bash
git commit dot_ansible/roles/homebrew/tasks/main.yml -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
ansible/homebrew: skip brew update if FETCH_HEAD < 24h old

brew update is a git fetch that can take 16+ minutes when the formula
repo hasn't been pulled in a while. upgrade_tools.sh brew already owns
the explicit update+upgrade path, so running it unconditionally on every
chezmoi apply violated the install-only invariant and wasted time.

Add a freshness guard: stat FETCH_HEAD mtime and skip the task when it
is younger than 86400 s. Use lookup('pipe','date +%s') rather than
ansible_date_time (which is unreliable on some macOS setups).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
```

分析完畢，三個問題：

**1. `tv update-channels` — 永遠 changed，永遠 18s**
`changed_when` 看的是 stderr，但輸出全在 stdout，stderr 永遠空字串 → `'already exists' not in ''` 永遠 True。且 `tv update-channels` 永遠先從 GitHub fetch 頻道列表才能判斷哪個要下載，所以就算頻道都存在也要 18s。

**2. `pre-commit --force` — 永遠 changed**
`--force` 強制每次重裝，uv 輸出就沒有 `already installed`，`changed_when` 永遠 True。

**3. `brew cleanup` — `ok` 但每次跑 9.5s**
每次都跑，可搭前面的 24h guard 一起 skip。

```bash
git commit dot_ansible/roles/devtools/tasks/main.yml dot_ansible/roles/security_tools/tasks/main.yml dot_ansible/roles/homebrew/tasks/main.yml -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
ansible: fix three always-changed/always-slow tasks

tv update-channels: add version-sentinel guard
- tv update-channels does a ~18s GitHub fetch on every apply even when
  all channels already exist; changed_when checked stderr which is always
  empty, so it always reported changed
- now: get `tv --version`, compare to ~/.config/television/.cable-version;
  skip entirely if version matches. Runs once on first apply or after a
  TV upgrade, writes the sentinel on completion.

pre-commit: remove --force from uv tool install
- --force reinstalled on every apply; uv without --force already outputs
  "already installed" which the existing changed_when correctly detects

brew cleanup: same 24h guard as brew update
- cleanup is most useful after an update/install; skipping both on the
  same FETCH_HEAD freshness window saves ~9.5s on non-stale runs

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-05-07 14:45:57Z)**_

Bug 是 `slurp` 在檔案不存在時會噴 `[ERROR]`（即使 `ignore_errors: true`，輸出仍然難看）。改成 `stat` + 在 `when` 裡用 `lookup('file', ...)` 短路——當 `stat.exists` 為 False 時，`or` 短路，`lookup` 根本不被求值，所以不會報錯。

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-05-07 14:46:16Z)**_

回答你的問題：**是的，第一次跑都會 ERROR**——原本設計是 `ignore_errors: true` 讓它靜默跳過，但 `slurp` 就算被 ignore 也會在輸出裡留下 `[ERROR]` 紅字，視覺上很難看。

現在改成 `stat` 之後：
- **第一次跑（sentinel 不存在）**：stat 回傳 `exists: false`，`not stat.exists` 為 True，`or` 短路，`lookup('file', ...)` 根本不跑 → 不會有任何 ERROR → task 正常執行、寫 sentinel
- **之後每次跑（版本相同）**：stat 回傳 `exists: true`，讀檔比對版本相同 → skip
